title: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting needs Cross Variable Loss
abstract: arXiv:2608.05742v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multivariate time series forecasting presents unique challenges because future variables often co-evolve under shared system dynamics. While existing studies mainly focus on cross-variable dependencies in historical observations, dependencies among future values are much less explored. Specifically, modern forecasting models largely follow the Direct Forecasting (DF) paradigm, generating multi-step forecasts with point-wise objectives that do not explicitly constrain cross-variable structure. In this work, we show that the DF objective is mismatched in the presence of cross-variable and lagged dependencies, revealing an objective gap. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{C}ross-\textbf{V}ariable \textbf{Loss} (CvLoss), a plug-in structural regularizer that constrains forecast residuals on a cross-variable graph. translated_title: 多变量时间序列预测需要跨变量损失
translated_abstract: 多变量时间序列预测带来了独特的挑战，因为未来的变量往往在共享的系统动态下共同演化。现有研究主要关注历史观测中的跨变量依赖关系，而对未来值之间的依赖关系却鲜有探索。具体而言，现代预测模型大多遵循直接预测范式，使用逐点目标函数生成多步预测，并未显式约束跨变量结构。在本工作中，我们证明了DF目标在存在跨变量依赖和滞后依赖的情况下是不匹配的，从而揭示了一个目标函数上的缺口。为解决这一问题，我们提出了跨变量损失，这是一种即插即用的结构正则化器，在跨变量图上对预测残差施加约束。CvLoss惩罚预测片段间不一致的边级残差差异，促进跨变量的一致性。
tldr: 本文提出跨变量损失，这是一种即插即用的结构正则化器，通过在跨变量图上约束预测残差，弥补了直接预测范式在跨变量依赖情形下的目标函数缺口。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Cross-Variable Loss (CvLoss), a plug-in structural regularizer that constrains forecast residuals on a cross-variable graph, addressing the objective gap of the Direct Forecasting paradigm under cross-variable dependencies.
